interpretation.temperature_1_control: Ordinary-CE control on exactly the same released full-LETTER ID bank; not the semantic-only TIGER baseline.
interpretation.instruments: Temperature 0.7 is the author-confirmed starting point.
interpretation.beauty_and_yelp: Transfer of the prespecified 0.7/1.0 endpoints; complete best TIGER settings for these datasets were not recovered.
interpretation.beauty_geometry_amendment: Retain two workers but use per-device batch512 and accumulation1 to avoid the legacy nonintegral accumulation epoch. Nominal batch1024 is preserved, but tail padding changes from171 to683 repeated examples and nominal 200-epoch updates from25600 to25800. This is not an exact replay of the original microbatch schedule.
interpretation.beauty_admission_evidence: Four-worker continuation had up to2.384185791015625e-7 weight drift despite identical RNG and a bitwise-identical fresh repeat; it was not admitted under the strict gate. The chosen two-worker512 geometry passed full-data interruptions64/129/130 with identical actual input/label traces, model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG, validation sequence and callback state.
interpretation.selection: Freeze each within-run selected checkpoint, report both temperatures; never choose the better temperature by test score or compare their validation-loss magnitudes.
interpretation.future_tuning: Any further search is separately versioned and selected only by validation ranking metrics.
